svg.text: How often does each scenario reproduce each observed difference? (16:36 scan against 13:20 scan)
Fraction of seeded simulated pairs (300-400 each) at least as extreme as observed, in the observed direction. 0 means none of the pairs.
METHOD ONLY, same tube T1: 16:36 rules against 13:20 rules
+ dark rate relaxing x2 -> x1, tau 600 s
+ dark rate relaxing x2 -> x1, tau 3000 s
+ 60 Hz modulation of the noise, depth 0.5
SAME TUBE + AN INTERMITTENT EXTRA NOISE SOURCE (environment, not method)
extra noise on/off (mean on 120 s, off 600 s)
extra noise on/off (mean on 900 s, off 900 s)
noise edge only: extra noise 2.4-6 mV
both: T1 then T2 (as tuned to the two scans)
both, same (current) rules for both scans

0 means none of 300-400 pairs (< ~1/300). In every row but the last, the earlier scan used the 13:20 rules and the later one the 16:36 rules, as in the real data; the last row uses the current rules for both.
